go build -gcflags='-l -d=coro=4' -o program .
stderr 'coro: phase=lower lowered=3 skipped=0'
go build -o auditor ./audit
exec ./auditor $GOROOT/bin/go program
stdout '^pointer-window-ok$'

exec ./program

-- go.mod --
module example.com/pointerresults

go 1.28
-- main.go --
package main
/*
#include <stdint.h>
#include <errno.h>
#cgo noescape pointer_value
#cgo nocallback pointer_value
#cgo noescape pointer_errno
#cgo nocallback pointer_errno
int64_t *pointer_value(int64_t *p) { return p; }
int64_t *pointer_errno(int64_t *p, int code) { errno=code; return p; }
*/
import "C"
import "syscall"

//go:noinline
func pointerCall(p *C.int64_t) *C.int64_t {
 result := C.pointer_value(p)
 return result
}
//go:noinline
func pointerErrno(p *C.int64_t, code C.int) (*C.int64_t,error) {
 result, err := C.pointer_errno(p, code)
 return result, err
}
func main() {
 var slot C.int64_t = 42
 value := pointerCall(&slot)
 withError, err := pointerErrno(&slot, C.EINVAL)
 withNilError, nilErr := pointerErrno(&slot, 0)
 nilValue := pointerCall(nil)
 nilPair, nilPairErr := pointerErrno(nil, 0)
 if value!=&slot || *value!=42 || withError!=&slot || err!=syscall.EINVAL ||
  withNilError!=&slot || nilErr!=nil || nilValue!=nil || nilPair!=nil || nilPairErr!=nil {
  panic("bad pointer result publication")
 }
 println("pointer-result-ok")
}
-- audit/main.go --
package main
import (
 "fmt"
 "os"
 "os/exec"
 "strings"
)
func main() {
 data,err:=exec.Command(os.Args[1],"tool","objdump","-s",`^main\.(pointerCall|pointerErrno)\.coro\.func1$`,os.Args[2]).CombinedOutput()
 if err!=nil { panic(string(data)) }
 active:=false
 calls:=0
 for _,line:=range strings.Split(string(data),"\n") {
  if strings.HasPrefix(line,"TEXT ") && active {panic("unterminated blocking window")}
  if strings.Contains(line,"CALL runtime.coroEnterBlocking") {if active {panic("nested blocking window")};active=true;calls++}
  if active && strings.Contains(line,"CALL runtime.gcWriteBarrier") {panic("pointer result write barrier before blocking exit: "+line)}
  if strings.Contains(line,"CALL runtime.coroExitBlocking") {if !active {panic("unmatched blocking exit")};active=false}
 }
 if active || calls!=2 {panic(fmt.Sprintf("blocking call windows=%d active=%t: %s",calls,active,data))}
 fmt.Println("pointer-window-ok")
}
